scope: CPU/source-only admission audit; no production edits and no GPU dispatch.

prebuild_inventory.meaning: Planning estimate only, not observed memory. The estimate is below 16 GiB numerically but admission is false due runtime count caps. Precompile compact-surface planning uses 4*T as upper bound; it omits the opt-in node-corner sort workspace, so it is not an exact runtime peak.

current_limits.classification: Node/tet and contact-count limits are admitted-scope/resource limits, not uint32 limits for this mesh.

incidence_sort_e1_capacity131072.note: Sort replaces the legacy per-node scan across active contacts for incidence construction. This is not timing evidence.

sparse_rigid_e1.caveat: Actual sparse broadphase occupancy is unknown.

conclusions.surface_alias: Deduplicates private surface primitives/BVH/radix-sort arrays against production buffers. Memory reduction only; does not remove N*K work.
conclusions.node_incidence_sort: The opt-in stable corner sort replaces O(nodeCount*activeCount) legacy count/scatter loops. It costs 12,582,912 bytes and 210 dispatches at capacity 131072.
conclusions.overflow: Deformable candidate count detects total>capacity and records NM_STATUS_CAPACITY_OVERFLOW; scatter checks environmentHealthy. Sparse candidate scan also records capacity overflow. No silent truncation found; adequacy of the capacities is unproved.
conclusions.estimator_gap: Runtime residentBytes includes sorted corner buffers (runtime.mm:6006-6044). The shipping estimate's persistent-contact formula does not include them; its precompile surface-face count is deliberately 4*T (shipping_memory.hpp:1284-1287). Opposing estimate effects mean the 14.66GB planning value is not an exact runtime peak.
conclusions.native: Source193 build receipt passed. Parent reports native validation refused before output-case creation because undeclared runtime.mm.orig changed scanned count 816->817. No native dispatch or shipping transaction.

next_slice: Add an exact compiled-layout preflight for this mesh that counts actual exterior faces, every buffer, alias, sort workspace, tile pages, sparse pair IDs, and resident bytes while keeping all caps and overflow behavior.

If that exact preflight admits, allow only an explicit shipping-specific topology scope, preserving all uint32/size_t/per-buffer checks and the 131072 candidate cap until native broadphase proves occupancy suffices.
If candidate occupancy exceeds the cap, add stable tiled candidate processing with complete history ownership and deterministic reduction; do not truncate or blanket-raise the cap.
